title: Chat GPT Flapjacks
method: Preheat oven to 170°C (150°C fan) and line a 20cm square tin.
Melt butter, brown sugar, and golden syrup in saucepan over low heat without boiling.
Stir in porridge oats and salt until every oat is coated.
Press mixture firmly into tin using back of a spoon.
Bake 18-22 minutes. Score into squares while warm; cool completely in tin.
